data.name: Before The Fade
data.detailed_description:
Before The Fade is a cinematic side-scrolling puzzle adventure set between the present day and the chaos of World War I. A sudden war tears your world apart and the woman you love is taken from you. In the aftermath of a devastating blast, you awaken in another time. To survive and to find her, you must rely not on brute force, but on wit, precision, and the help of your drone.

Across a series of hand-crafted levels you will solve environmental puzzles, overcome deadly obstacles, and use your drone to manipulate the battlefield. Push crates, open blocked paths, drop bombs from above, or combine multiple mechanics to move forward. Every stage introduces new challenges and forces you to think differently.

Enemy soldiers from both eras, guard dogs, collapsing structures, and war machines stand in your way. Sometimes the pace is tense and urgent, sometimes reflective and cinematic, but the journey is always forward. Towards the hope of finding her. Story moments and cutscenes connect each sequence into a narrative that blurs the line between past and present.

Your path is not about fighting. It is about persistence, problem-solving, and surviving.

Features

  • Cinematic side-scrolling adventure – immersive 2.5D world with shifting perspectives and dramatic cutscenes.

  • Evolving puzzle mechanics – each level introduces new challenges that must be combined in creative ways.

  • Atmospheric mix of action and puzzles – dodge enemies, outsmart guard dogs, and survive collapsing trenches.

  • Drone-based gameplay – call in and control your drone to move objects, open paths, and drop bombs.

  • Two wars across time – navigate both the modern battlefield and the chaos of World War I.

  • Story-driven journey – follow a personal tale of loss, determination, and the relentless search for the woman you love.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
